baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual construction ياليتها كانت القاضية anchors finality in كانت and the feminine predicate القاضية.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal occurrence is wished to have coincided with an enacted death and complete expiration, so an earlier event would have left no remainder capable of entering the speaker's present.

activation_trace.role: Being or occurrence in time makes the wish counterfactually recast what an earlier event was.
Death as an enacted end supplies the wished-for terminal event.
Completion and expiration sharpen death into an end that exhausts every sequel.

changed_reading.before: A bare lament that something had happened differently.
changed_reading.after: A wish that the earlier event had been an actually enacted, remainderless death or expiration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The definite predicate القاضية can characterize the wished antecedent as the event that decisively settles a matter.
baseline_models.mechanism: The wish retrospectively assigns an earlier occurrence the force of a binding ruling, not merely the property of being over.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication provides the counterfactual reassignment of the antecedent's status.
A decisive ruling or binding settlement makes القاضية the event that would close a case.

changed_reading.before: The speaker simply wishes for an end.
changed_reading.after: The speaker wishes that an earlier occurrence had itself possessed final adjudicative force.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The due-settlement branch of ق ض ي remains attached to القاضية, while كانت asks that this settlement already have occurred.
baseline_models.mechanism: Finality is modeled as a liability fully paid or collected: the wished event would not only stop life but discharge whatever remained outstanding.

activation_trace.role: Past occurrence locates the wished discharge before the present lament.
Settling or collecting a due supplies a transactional image of exhaustive closure.

changed_reading.after: Finality also means that no claim, debt, or obligation survives the wished event.

context_deltas.mechanism: A delivered written record is publicly read and exposes a reckoning. That sequence turns the focus's decisive-settlement branch into a procedural counterfactual: the speaker wishes the disclosed record had closed the case instead of initiating what follows.

activation_trace.role: The decisive ruling anchors the changed reading in القاضية as case-closing force.
A written inscription that imposes judgment gives the prospective ruling a documentary substrate.
Reading and recitation move the record from possession into public disclosure.
Counting and account identify the matter that the wished decisive event would have settled.

structural_cues: The two recipients are introduced through mirrored book-delivery and speech scenes.
The focus follows the second recipient's refusal of both book and knowledge of the account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, inscription, reading, account, and decisive ruling; I supply the procedural arrow from disclosure to hoped-for case closure. A live alternative is that القاضية names death alone and the legal sequence merely explains the lament.

changed_reading.before: القاضية is an unspecified decisive event.
changed_reading.after: القاضية is the wished final disposition of a documentary reckoning that has instead opened into enforcement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The successful sequence realizes a satisfying life, elevated garden, near fruit, and days made past through a cadence of feminine predicates. القاضية enters the same cadence as a negative counter-state: the failed recipient can name no inhabitable good condition and instead wishes for the condition that cancels all further conditions.

activation_trace.role: Completion and expiration make the focus predicate an anti-state that ends the descriptive series.
Death as enacted end gives that anti-state its terminal force.
Satisfaction opposed to displeasure supplies the achieved affective state against which القاضية turns.
The non-dominant mapped branch preserves acceptance as a second convergent scope of the positive predicate.
Elevation gives the positive state a realized vertical dimension.
Nearness makes the positive provision accessible rather than merely promised.
Time that has passed completes the positive sequence's temporal dimension.

structural_cues: راضية, عالية, دانية, خالية, and القاضية form a conspicuous feminine cadence across the two outcomes.
The earlier predicates describe possessed states, whereas القاضية occurs only inside an unrealized wish.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the recurring feminine forms and their affective, spatial, and temporal branches; I infer that their ordered cadence makes القاضية a counter-state rather than an isolated rhyme. The live alternative is phonological parallelism without a shared semantic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an isolated wish for death.
changed_reading.after: The wish answers the other recipient's achieved states with a single unrealized anti-state: let there have been no state after the finalizer.

context_deltas.mechanism: What was advanced in prior days becomes an account; the successful side receives untroubled provision, while the failed side is identified by not mobilizing provision for the immobilized poor and receives a harsh anti-food. The due-settlement branch of القاضية therefore becomes a wish that death could have discharged an obligation which the context presents as still collectible.

activation_trace.role: Settling and collecting dues anchors the focus in an outstanding-obligation model.
The account supplies the explicit ledger whose balance remains unknown to the speaker.
Property advanced beforehand gives prior conduct the structure of value paid forward.
Feeding another supplies the omitted social due rather than food as private consumption alone.
Sustenance that stabilizes residence makes feeding materially restore a person whose condition has arrested movement.
The branch's heat and severity turn the received food into punitive provision rather than discharge.

structural_cues: The feast for what was advanced precedes the focus, while failure to urge feeding and the exclusive punitive food follow it.
The causal explanation in 69:33-34 interrupts the enforcement sequence to identify what remained morally unpaid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advance, account, omitted feeding, stabilizing sustenance, and punitive food; I supply the reciprocal arrow that treats omission as an unpaid due collected after the wish. The live alternative is a moral contrast without transactional equivalence.

changed_reading.before: The wished end would settle an unspecified liability.
changed_reading.after: The speaker wishes death could discharge the account, but the food reversal exposes a social due that survives and returns as collection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Past days, the severe present day, and the later causal كان make time porous: prior conduct remains present as evidence. The focus's كانت القاضية is consequently a wish for a temporal seal that would make the past truly expire, while the repeated كان demonstrates that the speaker's former mode of being has crossed into today.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication anchors the wish to what the antecedent should already have become.
Expiration supplies the desired impermeable boundary after the earlier event.
The present day's event and severity provide the temporal destination the past has entered.
The passing away of time marks prior days as gone without making their effects empty.
The repeated past predication carries former nonbelief forward as the cause of present enforcement.

structural_cues: 69:24 labels the earlier days past, 69:27 wishes for expiration, and 69:35 insists on today.
The second كان in 69:33 introduces enduring causal biography after the wished temporal closure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies past days, today, repeated كان, and expiration; I infer that remembered conduct crosses the boundary the speaker wants sealed. A live alternative is ordinary retrospection with no special temporal mechanism in the focus.

changed_reading.before: كانت simply places a desired ending in the past.
changed_reading.after: كانت asks for a past made causally dead, but the later كان shows that the speaker's past remains operative in the present.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the wish, wealth loses sufficiency and authority receives the verb of perishing, yet the speaker remains available to be seized. The sequence clarifies القاضية as desired terminality for the self, sharply distinguished from the mere collapse of the self's supports and proxies.

activation_trace.role: Death as enacted end locates the requested extinction in the speaker rather than in possessions.
Exhaustive expiration distinguishes terminality from partial dispossession.
Failed sufficiency shows that an external resource cannot answer the present need.
Accumulated wealth supplies the first proxy that falls away without ending its owner.
Perishing is grammatically assigned to authority, making the speaker's own non-perishing conspicuous.
Power and jurisdiction identify the protective proxy that perishes before arrest.

structural_cues: The first two clauses after 69:27 strip away wealth and authority before commands act directly on the person.
Only the speaker's authority is said to perish; the speaker persists as the object of four ensuing commands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed wealth, perished authority, and the still-seizable person; I infer a deliberate proxy-versus-self contrast that specifies what القاضية was wanted to terminate. The live alternative is that هلك سلطانيه is only a conventional statement of lost power.

changed_reading.before: The lament asks generally for death to have been final.
changed_reading.after: The lament asks for the self, not merely its wealth or authority, to have received the perishing that the next verses pointedly withhold from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus commands carry out arrest, restraint, exposure to fire, and insertion into a chain. They activate ق ض ي as execution of an action while frustrating its death-and-expiration branches: everything is executed except the terminal end the speaker requested.

activation_trace.role: Perfected execution gives the following commands the form of an action carried fully through.
Death as enacted end supplies the result that the command sequence never grants.
Capture and arrest initiate execution against a subject who remains present.
A collar that binds the body converts judgment into durable restraint.
Meeting the fire supplies bodily enforcement without semantic completion.
The non-dominant mapped root independently preserves contact with fire as the operative image.
Insertion of one thing into another makes the final command continue the process rather than end it.

structural_cues: Four imperatives advance stepwise from seizure to chaining, fire, and insertion.
The focus requests one finalizer, but the response is a serial procedure with repeated ثم and فاء transitions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a perfected-action branch and an ordered enforcement sequence; I infer that the sequence enacts one sense of قضاء while denying its death sense. A live alternative is that the commands merely narrate punishment after an independently understood death wish.

changed_reading.before: القاضية fuses execution and terminal result into one wished event.
changed_reading.after: The context splits them: judgment is relentlessly executed, but execution does not become the terminal death the speaker wanted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps the joining branch of writing onto literal bodily linkage. It remains anchored in القاضية as decisive ruling and in the packet's record-to-chain order, but downstream prose should present it as a cross-domain material analogy, not as the lexical meaning of كتاب or القاضية.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: القاضية anchors a decisive verdict whose binding force can be tracked from written record to attached body.

activation_trace.role: A binding ruling supplies the legal force that the material sequence makes physical.
Joining one thing to another exposes a latent material image inside the delivered record.
The collar turns abstract binding into restraint at the body.
Connected rings extend binding into a serial material structure.
Insertion completes the analogy by placing the judged person inside the linked structure.

changed_reading.before: The book contains a judgment and the chain later enforces it.
changed_reading.after: The wished decisive closure fails because documentary binding propagates into bodily binding, link after link.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because ordinary كانت is temporal predication, not an overt suretyship form. It remains worth carrying because the focus inventory explicitly supplies the undertaking branch and the context removes wealth, authority, and intimate support in sequence; prose must label it a latent root resonance rather than a grammatical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The suretyship branch remains tied to the focus root ك و ن in كانت, while القاضية supplies the ruling against which surety would matter.

activation_trace.role: Undertaking responsibility activates the odd possibility that the wished antecedent should have stood for the speaker.
The binding ruling establishes the pressure under which a guarantor would be sought.
Failed sufficiency removes wealth as something able to answer for the speaker.
Lost power and jurisdiction remove institutional protection.
The absent close relation removes personal kinship support as the last possible surety.

changed_reading.before: كانت only asks what the antecedent had been.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the root inventory, the lament also sounds like a wish that something had undertaken the speaker's case when every worldly sponsor failed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the waterskin-decay branch of ق ض ي against the usual death and completion senses. It remains anchored in القاضية and gains a mechanism from explicit failure to urge feeding plus the later wash-derived punitive substance; prose should frame it as an analogy of cumulative neglect, never as a direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rare neglect-decay branch is cited directly from القاضية and changes the temporal texture of its finality.

activation_trace.role: A waterskin spoiled by being left too long supplies finality as accumulated deterioration rather than one sudden stroke.
Urging toward action, explicitly negated in context, makes omission causally visible.
Feeding another identifies the unattended material responsibility.
The washing medium and what is washed in it retain the container-and-residue material field of spoilage.

changed_reading.before: القاضية imagines a sudden final stroke.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also expose an end produced by long moral neglect, with the unattended obligation returning as spoiled provision.

strongest_changes: The book, public reading, and account turn a generic decisive end into the wished final disposition of a documentary proceeding.
The feminine cadence makes القاضية an unrealized anti-state set against the other recipient's satisfying, elevated, near, and completed states.
Failed wealth and perished authority distinguish loss of proxies from terminality of the self.
The arrest-to-chain sequence executes judgment perfectly while denying the completion or death requested by القاضية.
The feast, omitted feeding, and punitive food strengthen the exploratory reading of finality as discharge of an unpaid social due.
summary.what_was_special: Only two focus roots generate several live mechanisms: temporal seal, enacted death, decisive verdict, completed execution, and settled due. Context does not collapse them; it repeatedly separates procedural execution from terminal result and lets legal, temporal, material, social, and morphological readings coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine pronoun's antecedent is not resolved by the focus line itself, so documentary, experiential, and death-oriented attachments must remain distinct.
The procedural and debt models may be contextual overlays on the terminal-death reading rather than independent lexical construals.
The suretyship and neglect-decay outliers are intentionally branch-distant and should remain qualified latent resonances.
